as_told.title: Jake told Greer craft were being downed

plain: A man named Jake Barber is said to have been at sites around the world where extraterrestrial craft were deliberately targeted and brought down. The account comes from Steven Greer, a longtime UFO activist, who tells Michels that Barber told him this himself ("he's been a site where we've targeted these ET craft and down them") and who points to a briefing document with a map of the sites. In an earlier episode Michels passes on Greer's account and adds that Barber was deeply troubled by it, which, if true, would mean someone has been shooting down visitors' craft.
